business_model.claim: American Tower earns most of its revenue by leasing space on communications real estate (towers, DAS networks, rooftops, fiber and data centers) to wireless carriers, broadcasters, government agencies and other tenants. Property operations were 97% of total revenue in 2025 and 98% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
quotes: Our primary business is the leasing of space on communications sites to wireless service providers, radio and television broadcast companies, wireless data providers, government agencies and municipalities and tenants in a number of other industries.

business_model.claim: Revenue is contractual and recurring. an inflationary index in most of our international markets

Nine-month 2026 churn was approximately 5% of tenant billings, against approximately 2% in 2025, and DISH-related impairment charges were $17.5 million. DISH was approximately 2% of 2025 total property revenue and 4% of U.S. & Canada property revenue.
quotes: On June 30, 2026, DISH filed petitions for relief under chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A (P4) and the 10-K risk factors (P2). The 10-K warns that adverse rulings could have a material negative impact.
risks.claim: The AT&T Mexico arbitration challenges the lease calculation under the master lease agreement. The customer represented approximately $300 million of 2025 tenant revenue, and the company recorded approximately $30 million of additional reserves in the nine months of 2026.
quotes: The Arbitration hearing began in August 2026 and we expect a final ruling in 2027.
We expect to record future reserves until the Arbitration is settled.

risks.basis: Balance-sheet and cash-flow figures are stated in F1 and F3. The refinancing mechanism is inferred from the 10-K risk language.
risks.claim: The company carries heavy debt that needs refinancing. Current portion of long-term obligations rose to 5,363.5 from 3,387.8 (table in millions), against cash and cash equivalents of 1,871.9 (table in millions). The company is issuing new notes, including $1,474.9 million of net proceeds in November 2026, to repay the revolver and for general corporate purposes.
quotes: We have a substantial amount of indebtedness.
The Company intends to use the net proceeds to repay existing indebtedness under its $6.0 billion senior unsecured multicurrency revolving credit facility and for general corporate purposes.
